---
# Front matter that used to stop the render or be ignored.
#
# Should: render a title that ends in emphasis and has a subtitle; fall back
# to two blank lines when blank-lines-above-author-note is not a number; and
# leave the .pdf with no running head when suppress-short-title is set.
#
# Used to: crash on the title (apastriptitle.lua read the text of its last
# inline, which emphasis has none of); crash on the blank lines
# (math.floor of nil); and print the short title in the .pdf running head
# regardless, where typst and .docx left it out.
title: "A Title Ending in *Zqemphasis*"
subtitle: "Zqsubtitle"
shorttitle: "Zqshort"
suppress-short-title: true
blank-lines-above-author-note: many
author:
  - name: Test Author
    corresponding: true
    email: test@example.com
    affiliations:
      - name: Test University
format:
  apaquarto-html: default
  apaquarto-docx: default
  apaquarto-typst: default
  apaquarto-pdf: default
---

Zqbody.
